fieldValues.title: The srs CLI cannot update a vocabulary term, so stale guidance stays in a package
fieldValues.summary: Fixing review feedback on srs-web#647, a term description in the help repository's placement vocabulary named a mechanism that no longer exists. The CLI has vocabulary create and term-create but no update for either, so the text could not be corrected without hand-editing package JSON, which the rules forbid.
fieldValues.body: - Filed srs-rust#1526 and left the text; the stop is small but recurs for any vocabulary wording fix.
